He sits in front of a professional black microphone on an orange table, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. The background consists of vertical off-white curtains and a small colorful logo in the top right corner. Blue and white variety text overlays identify him. (2) The screen switches to a split-screen layout. The top half shows two young females, one in a grey sweatshirt and glasses, the other in a black hoodie, both wearing headphones and speaking into microphones. The bottom half shows the male from phase (1) and another male with blonde hair and glasses in a black jacket. They are all in the same studio environment with professional audio equipment. (3) The male in the striped shirt continues his animated storytelling, his facial expressions shifting from neutral to wide-eyed and then covering his eyes with his right hand to mimic fear. Large, stylized red and white variety text overlays appear frequently, pulsing on screen to emphasize his points. The lighting remains consistent, providing bright studio illumination across the subjects.
